content: Azazettonttayssa Bolla Gakkiza Qixaate
GODAY Muse hizgides,

«Isra7eele nayta, ‹Inttena gidikkonne intte giddon diza hara dere asatappe oonikka molooke geetetti xeygettiza eeqa xoossas ba naytappe issaa aaththi immi beettiko kumeththa Isra7eele dere asay hessaade shuchchan caddi wodho.

Oonikka ba naytappe issaade molookes aaththi immidi ta keeththaa tunisida gishshassinne geeshshaa sunththaa tayssa kawushshida gishshas ta hessaade bolla qixaate yeddana; hessafe guye ta izaades morkke gidada dere giddofe iza shaakka dhayssana.
Iza dere asay izaadey ooththoyssa ubbaaka wudettontta bessi aggikonne wodhontta aggiko,

tani ta baggara hessaadenne izaadeso asaa qasseka taas ammanettontta molookes goynnon izara issife gididayta ubbaa bolla iita hanqo yeddana; hessafe guye heytantta tani istta istta dereza giddofe shaakka dhayssana.
« ‹Oonikka isttafe zore oychchanaas moytille xeygizaytakkonne marotakko biikko hessaade bolla ta iita hanqo yeddana; hessafe guye hessaade tani iza dere giddofe shaakka dhayssana.
« ‹Intte asateth ubbaa geeshshite; dummatite; gaasoykka tani GODAA intte Xoossaa.
Ta azazoyo naagitenne polite; gaasoykka tani inttena taas dummasida intte GODAA.
« ‹Ba aawa woykko ba aayo cayizaadey hayqon qaxxayetto; izi hayqon qaxxayettizay ba mooronna.
« ‹Issi asi hara asa machchira laymatikko he laymatida addezaranne maccassayra nam7ayka hayqon qaxxayettetto.
Issi asi ba aawa machchira laymatikko ba aawa kawushshida gishshas he laymatidayti nam7ayka hayqon qaxxayettetto; istti hayqon qaxxayettizay ba moorida mooronna.
Issi asi baas naaza machchira laymatikko he laymatidayti nam7ayka hayqon qaxxayettetto; asho dabboteth layman tunisida gishshas istti hayqon qaxxayettizay ba moorida mooronna.
« ‹Issi asi maccara zin7iza mala addey addera zin7iko nam7ayka yeellachchiza miish ooththida gishshas hayqon qaxxayettetto; istti hayqon qaxxayettizay ba moorida mooronna.
« ‹Issi asi aayeyonne nayo machcho ekkiko heytantti ooththida harassiza hanoza gishshas heedzdzayka taman xuugetti hayqqetto; heytantta mala iita hanoy intte giddon polettanaas bessenna.
« ‹Ay asikka mehera paratikko izaadeynne he mehezi nam7ay hayqqetto.
« ‹Issi maccassi mehera paratikko izanne he iza parattida mehey nam7ay hayqqetto; istti hayqqizay ba moorida mooronna.

« ‹Issi asi ba michchiyo, baas aayi nayo woykko aawa nayo machcho ekkiko hessi yeellachchizaaza; hessa gishshas istti bantta dere giddofe shaaketti dhayetto; ba ooththida mooro gishshas ba qixaate ekketto.

« ‹Issi asi aginan aginan beettiza maccassa wogay beettida maccassara zin7iko izaadey izi kalloteth qaarida gishshassinne izakka ba kalloteththaa qaara bessida gishshas nam7ayka bantta dere giddofe shaaketti dhayetto.
« ‹Ay asikka ba aawa michchira woykko ba aayi michchira zin7ofo; hessaththo ooththizaa gidikko nam7ayka bantta dabboteththa kawushshiza gishshas ba moorida mooron oyshettana.
« ‹Ay asikka ba aawa isha machchira woykko ba aayey isha machchira laymatikko ba aawa isha machcho woykko ba aayi isha yeellasida gishshas laymatidayti nam7ayka oyshettananne yeloy baynda attana.
Ay asikka ba isha machcho ekkizaa gidikko hessi tuna ooththees; ba ishaza bonchcho kawushshida gishshas nam7ayka naa yelontta attana.
« ‹Ta inttena izin gelththana Kanaane biittaya inttena cutta diggontta mala intte ta azazotanne ta wogata naagitenne polite.
Tani intte sinththafe dhayssiza kawoteththata lose woga kaallofte; istti heytantta ubbaa ooththida gishshas ta istta shaatettadis.

Ta qasse izippe maaththinne eessi goggiza he cilila biittayo inttena gelththanaas caaqqadis; izokka ta inttes immana; hankko dereppe intte taas shaakettidayta gidana mala ooththiday tana GODAA intte Xoossaa.

« ‹Hessa gishshas intte geesh gidida mehetanne kafota tuna gididaytappe lo7eththidi shaakki erite; tani haytanti inttes tuna ga woththida mehetan, kafotaninne biitta bolla qaaxxiza ay miishshankka inttena tunisopite.
Intte taas dumma shaakettidayta gidite; gaasoykka tani GODAY dumma Xoossa; intte ta dereta gidana mala Ayzaabeta giddofe tani inttena taas dummasa shaakkadis.
« ‹Ay asikka intte giddofe moytille xeygizaa woykko marotizaade gidikko izi shuchchan cadetti hayqo; hessaththo ooththizaadey ay asikka hayqon qaxxayettizay ba ooththida mooronna› ga yoota.»
